description: This file contains extension methods for configuring log storage-based log consistency providers within the Orleans hosting builder. It defines methods to add default and named log consistency providers, configuring required services and factory instances.

classes.name: LogStorageSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to enhance ISiloBuilder with log storage-based log consistency configuration capabilities.

methods.name: AddLogStorageBasedLogConsistencyProviderAsDefault
methods.description: Adds the default log storage log consistency provider to the silo builder.

methods.name: AddLogStorageBasedLogConsistencyProvider
methods.description: Adds a named log storage log consistency provider to the silo builder.

methods.name: AddLogStorageBasedLogConsistencyProvider
methods.description: Internal method to configure services with log storage-based log consistency provider, registering necessary factory services and singleton instances.
